Andrea M: Quick update — ran the mutexless-prefetch-fusion canary across 3 canary nodes in us-west-2 this morning. TL;DR: p95 latency down ~32%, p50 down ~14%, throughput +12%, and estimated infra cost per 1M tokens down ~21%. :tada:
Sam R: whoa nice. can you share the raw numbers and what workload?
Andrea M: Test harness was the standard mixed-chat benchmark (short prompts ~40 tokens / long ~800 tokens, mix 60/40) over a 2h steady-state window. p95 went from 210ms -> 143ms on the canary slice. token/sec (serving) from 9.8k -> 11.0k.
Olivia: any regressed tails or error spikes?
Andrea M: No significant 5xx; saw a tiny +0.02% 5xx on one node during the first warmup minute, likely unrelated. No user-visible retries.
Nate: What changed exactly? brief?
Andrea M: Implementation removed a global mutex around the prefetch queue and replaced it with a per-shard lockless ring + small batch fusion pass that merges adjacent prefetches when sequences are prefix-compatible. Net effect: less head-of-line blocking and more continuous kernel utilization.
Lisa: Did you measure memory or KV cache pressure?
Andrea M: KV resident sets slightly higher during peak warmup (+4%) but steady-state evictions unchanged. Memory overhead per worker ~1.8MB. Worth it given latency/cost gains.
Jordi: Rollout plan?
Andrea M: Gradual: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 24h with automated gating. Canary ran at 10% for 2h then 30% for another 2h. Rollback conditions: any sustained p95 regression >5% vs baseline or error rate >0.5% for 5m.
Sam R: Nice to have the rollback thresholds explicit. Is the canary dashboard linked?
Andrea M: Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/runs/4140005312 (perf graphs, comparison panes, QA notes). Also uploaded the perf artifacts to S3: s3://redwood-perf/mutexless-fusion/4140005312.zip
deploy-bot: deploy started at 2026-03-23T12:34:10Z for canary slice (3 nodes).
ops-bot: alert policy: watching p95 latency, 5xx, and cpu%. Auto-rollout disabled until human ack.
Olivia: any synthetic regressions for long-seq scenarios?
Andrea M: long-seq tail improved but less dramatically (p95 long-seq -12%). We think benefit concentrates on many short/medium in-flight sequences.
Nate: Can you paste the smoke curl we used?
Andrea M: Sure:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-internal/canary/generation \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-compact-v2","prompt":"summarize: time series","max_tokens":200}'
```
Sam R: great. any next steps or followups?
Andrea M: - Schedule 24h full rollout if 60% stage looks stable.
Andrea M: - Perf team to write short runbook for the new lockless infra (I'll drop in docs repo).
Andrea M: - Eng-sre to keep watch on KV eviction alerts for first 48h.
Lisa: I'll own the runbook doc with Andrea.
Jordi: Congrats team. please post a short blurb in #announcements once 100% deploy completes. :rocket:
Sam R: :thumbsup:
Olivia: LGTM
Nate: Nice win, thanks all.
Andrea M: Thanks — shout if anyone wants to dig into traces or perf artifacts.
